name: Signify N.V.
summary: Signify N.V., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells lighting products in Europe, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through Digital Solutions, Digital Products, and Conventional Products segments. The company offers light-emitting diode (LED) and conventional luminaires, systems, and services for various market segments comprising offices, commercial buildings, shops, hospitality, industry, and outdoor environments that include smart cities. It also provides various LED lamps, including spots, bulbs, and tubes for the professional and consumer channels; and LED electronic components, such as LED drivers and modules for luminaire original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), as well as for professional luminaire applications in the retail, office, and outdoor segments, as well as develops and sells connected lighting systems and luminaires. In addition, the company produces and sells lamps, which comprise high intensity discharge lamps, TL, compact fluorescent, halogen, incandescent; electronic components, including electronic ballast and drivers; and specialty lighting products, as well as digital projection lamps and drivers to the OEM market and replacement market. It provides its conventional lamps to consumers, electrical installers, and professional end-users through various channels for use in residential and professional applications; and lamp electronics for luminaire manufacturers directly, as well as replacement products through electrical wholesalers. The company was formerly known as Philips Lighting N.V. and changed its name to Signify N.V. in May 2018. Signify N.V. was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands.
